body.statement: For every \(D_1\)-measurable \(\widehat S\in\mathcal A\), the moment-projection interval obeys \[\liminf_{n_2\to\infty}\inf_{\vartheta\in\Theta}\operatorname*{ess\,inf}_{D_1}P_{\vartheta}\{b_{\widehat S}(\vartheta)\in J_{\widehat S}\mid D_1\}\ge1-\alpha.\] This whole-image claim includes every equality parameter \(\vartheta\in\Theta\) satisfying \(b_{\widehat S}(\vartheta)=0\), for which \(\nu_{\widehat S}^2(\vartheta)=0\) and ordinary Wald inference is unavailable.
body.justification: Projection restores honest coverage exactly on the equality boundary where first-order studentization degenerates.
body.gap: Imbens--Manski and Stoye address collapsing estimated bounds under regular Gaussian endpoint limits; the proposed interval instead projects primitive Gaussian moments and remains valid when the selected endpoint has zero first derivative.
body.consumer: Empirical users obtain a conservative fallback that covers the selected causal lower endpoint over the entire compact moment image \(\Theta\).
